definitions.full: H6834. Tsippor II. צִמּוֺר proper name, masculine father of Balak, king of Moab ( bird ; perhaps specifically sparrow , compare Gray Prop. N. 94 ; Palmyrene proper name, masculine צפרא ); — ׳צ Num 22:2 , 4 , 16 ; Josh 24:9 ; Judg 11:25 , צִמֹּר Num 22:10 ; 23:18 ; Σεπφωρ .

occurrences.englishText: Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites.
Moab said to the elders of Midian, “Now this multitude will lick up all that is around us, as the ox licks up the grass of the field.”
Balaam said to God, “Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, has said to me,
They came to Balaam, and said to him, “Balak the son of Zippor says, ‘Please let nothing hinder you from coming to me,
He took up his parable, and said,
Then Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, arose and fought against Israel. He sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse you,
Now are you anything better than Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab? Did he ever strive against Israel, or did he ever fight against them?
